purpose: Select epistemic depth from current risk/evidence signals without constraining reasoning to a fixed questionnaire, and fail closed before material mutation when required deliberation has not been satisfied.
principles: Triggers decide when deeper deliberation is required; current evidence generates the actual questions and methods.
Move micro -> macro -> micro: reproduce the concrete symptom, challenge goal/assumption/topology when warranted, then return to the smallest correct change and concrete verification.
Do not default to multi-agent debate, architecture search or self-reflection rituals.
Same-model critique is candidate-generation evidence, not independent verification.
When a knowledge/method/architecture gap exists, actively search external evidence and compare properties, fit, costs, failure modes and rejected alternatives.
Material proposals should be challenged by counterexamples; high-risk or disputed outcomes require genuinely independent evidence when available.

Stop deliberating when evidence is sufficient for the risk level, contradictions are resolved or explicitly bounded, and the plan demonstrably advances the governing done-condition without unnecessary complexity.

before_mutation: construct current DeliberationSignals from observed evidence rather than from the preferred solution
satisfy every escalation dimension marked required before promoting the proposed architecture/governance mutation
when external_research_required is true, gather external evidence before choosing the governing abstraction
when counterexample_search_required is true, test at least one plausible alternative or failure counterexample
do not call a same-model critique independent verification
closure_guard: scan all current top-level authorities that can encode the changed semantic, including ENTRYPOINT, CURRENT_SYSTEM, session/binding/authority policies, task/router state and affected domain bindings
resolve or explicitly bound every contradiction before reporting RESOLVED
run reproducible evaluation on the final candidate tree and post-promotion observation on production authority
material_change_admission.host_note: CHATGPT_GITHUB raw connector calls are outside the Python ActionCoordinator, so the host/session must apply this admission rule before material repository mutation; CI invariants provide independent regression detection for durable contradictions.

anti_bloat: Extend existing Control Kernel/Context/Assurance/Evolution before adding a subsystem.
Every new mechanism must state overlap, replacement/retirement, or why extension is impossible.
Do not turn guidance principles into accumulating guarantee prose when an invariant can be encoded as a contract/test/fitness property.
